items.desc_now: Cursor-style draft chats for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): New Session reuses the empty draft — and only mints a fresh one when every draft has unsent text — so empty placeholders never stack, exactly like Cursor's (or Telegram's) chat list.
items.desc_prev: Cursor-style New Session for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): every click mints a fresh durable draft session — plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.

items.desc_now: Queue, Steer, and Backlog for DSH. More diverse way to interact with the agent while it's running.
